title: Transfer from abelian to module units with independent universes
statement: Let $X,Z$ be schemes in universe $t$ [def-pc-scheme], $i:Z\to X$ any morphism, and $V$ an object of the actual small pro-etale site of $X$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Fix an independent universe $u$ and put $r=\max(u,t+1)$. Let $R,S$ be sheaves of rings of size $r$ on $X,Z$, and let $c:R\to i_*S$ be a ring-sheaf morphism, where direct image is actual sectionwise pro-etale direct image [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. Let $L\dashv i_*$ on ring sheaves and assume the ring adjunct $L(R)\to S$ of $c$ is invertible. Let $B\dashv i_*$ on abelian sheaves of size $r$. Let $P\dashv i_*$ on module sheaves of size $r$, with direct image through the coefficient action of $c$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For every $R$-module sheaf $M$, if the abelian adjunction unit on the underlying abelian sheaf is bijective on $V$-sections, then the unit of the specified module adjunction on $M$ is also bijective on $V$-sections. No affineness, closed immersion, specialization or completeness hypothesis occurs.

source.place: Tag 03D2, lemma-pullback-module; Tag 03D3, lemma-adjoint-push-pull-modules, with the normalized adjunction-unit equations.

proof.text: Transport the ring and abelian adjunctions to coefficient-sized AsSmall site models using fully faithful restriction. Their units are the original units reindexed. The adjunct of the transported coefficient map is the inverse-equivalence image of its original adjunct and hence is invertible. The supplied sectionwise abelian bijection is therefore valid on the small model of V.

Compare the transported ring left adjoint with canonical ring inverse image. The inverse coefficient adjunct followed by the uniqueness isomorphism identifies the target ring with inverse image of the source ring. The adjunction unit equation, followed by the canonical forgetful comparison unit equation, gives a normalized set-sheaf pullback presentation of the coefficient morphism.

Apply the normalized module/abelian inverse-image action and adjunction comparison. Evaluate its unit equation at the model of V. The abelian unit is bijective and the comparison is invertible, so cancel the latter. Uniqueness of module left adjoints compares canonical pullback with any supplied small-site module adjunction, again preserving sectionwise invertibility.

Compose canonical small-site module pullback with the two module equivalences to the actual sites. Its direct image is actual coefficient-restricted pushforward by the sectionwise identity isomorphism. Its unit is the composite of two invertible equivalence units and the reindexed module unit, so evaluation is invertible. Compare with the supplied actual-site module adjunction using unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app, and cancel the invertible comparison on the target. This includes empty schemes and the zero ring.

theorem proEtale_module_unit_bijective_of_abelian
    {X Z : Scheme.{t}} (i : Z ⟶ X) (V : X.ProEt)
    (R : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) RingCat.{max u (t + 1)})
    (S : Sheaf (ProEt.topology Z) RingCat.{max u (t + 1)})
    (c : R ⟶ ((proEtaleBaseChange i).sheafPushforwardContinuous
      RingCat.{max u (t + 1)} (ProEt.topology X) (ProEt.topology Z)).obj S)
    (L : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) RingCat.{max u (t + 1)} ⥤
      Sheaf (ProEt.topology Z) RingCat.{max u (t + 1)})
    (aL : L ⊣ (proEtaleBaseChange i).sheafPushforwardContinuous
      RingCat.{max u (t + 1)} (ProEt.topology X) (ProEt.topology Z))
    [IsIso ((aL.homEquiv R S).symm c)]
    (B : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) AddCommGrpCat.{max u (t + 1)} ⥤
      Sheaf (ProEt.topology Z) AddCommGrpCat.{max u (t + 1)})
    (aB : B ⊣ (proEtaleBaseChange i).sheafPushforwardContinuous
      AddCommGrpCat.{max u (t + 1)} (ProEt.topology X) (ProEt.topology Z))
    (P : SheafOfModules.{max u (t + 1)} R ⥤ SheafOfModules.{max u (t + 1)} S)
    (aP : P ⊣ SheafOfModules.pushforward c)
    (M : SheafOfModules.{max u (t + 1)} R)
    (habelian : Function.Bijective
      ((aB.unit.app ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf R).obj M)).hom.app (op V))) :
    Function.Bijective ((aP.unit.app M).val.app (op V))
